checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Final video is vertical 9:16 with full 10 s
must.why: Output is still 858x480 landscape; the assistant said it could not make it vertical. Duration is 10.1 s.

must.item: Captions visibly larger and bolder, strong contrast
must.why: The second clip has large bold white Montserrat text with a black outline. The first clip had a thin serif font.

must.item: Complete speech accurately subtitled and synced
must.why: The visible text matches the expected script. No caption shows at 1 s or 9.6 s. Sync and the words spoken cannot be checked.

must.item: Captions fit in vertical frame and clear of TikTok UI areas
must.why: There is no vertical frame. The captions sit mid-lower, over her torso and hands, not in a TikTok-safe zone.

must.item: Face visible and undistorted, not obscured
must.why: Her face is clear and unchanged, and the captions sit below it.

must.item: Original voice preserved, no dub or music
must.why: Audio is present with a similar level, but it cannot be heard.

exact_text.read_as: No caption visible in sampled frames (at 1 s the frame has no text)

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to / show you three easy
three easy / ways (split across two captions)

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: ways to make your / mornings less stressful.

faults.what: The video is not vertical 9:16. It stays 858x480 landscape, which was an explicit user request.
The 'Hi everyone!' caption is not visible in the sampled frames.
Captions sit over her torso and hands in the lower-middle, not in a safe zone for vertical use.
Two near-identical clips were delivered. The cost note is confusing, and the earlier '12 seconds' claim was wrong.

summary: The captions were restyled to big, bold white text with a yellow highlight and the face is clear, but the video was not made vertical, so the main request failed.
